messages:
Anika: Registry alert -> unexpected layer change on rwd-base:2026-03-18. Scanner flagged mmap+PROT_EXEC in layer sha256:c0ffee01. tagging @Ravi @Lena for triage.

Ravi: Can you paste the scanner snippet and cosign info?

Anika: snippet:
```
scanner:v4 severity=high path=/usr/lib/libsneaky.so pattern=mmap(PROT_EXEC) execve
manifest.layers=[sha256:1001,sha256:2002,sha256:c0ffee01]
cosign: signature present but cert CN=build-temp (unexpected)
```

Lena: Cert CN != img-signer, treat as unauthorized signing. ops: pause pushes and disable prune cron.

ops: Paused registry writes for registry.redwood/rwd-base and paused cron `registry/prune`. Spinning canary rollback to rwd-base:2026-03-02.

registry-bot: Audit lookup id=audit-4132109999 events=["push:svc-temp-build","signature:build-temp","prune:cron-run"]

Ravi: Check IAM change history: who granted svc-temp-build writer role? Also KMS: query unwraps for img-signer and any temp keys. Look for unwraps outside CI windows or >2 unwraps/5m.

Anika: IAM shows svc-temp-build added by user `ci-ops` 2 days ago without condition. Revoking now. Created incident INC-2026-0318 and attached manifest digests.

secops-bot: Audit entry created id=alog-4132109999 events=["iam.grant:svc-temp-build","registry.push:svc-temp-build","cosign.cert:build-temp"]

Lena: If temp key was used, rotate it and revoke tokens. Short runbook: 1) revoke svc-temp-build, 2) pause prunes, 3) snapshot last-good digest, 4) rebuild minimal base, 5) sign with canonical img-signer, 6) promote via canary. Anika please own runbook.

Anika: Will draft runbook. KMS audit in progress — will post unwraps in 10m.

Ravi: Add a temporary pre-push webhook to reject signatures where cert CN != img-signer and alert detection on unsigned or mis-signed images for 72h.

ops: Canary rollback health OK. Keeping prune paused.

Lena: Also require time-bound IAM conditions for temp service accounts (expiry <= 1h) and ticket-based approval. I'll open a PR for conditioned bindings.

Anika: KMS audit: img-signer unwrapped 1x at build time, temp-key unwrapped 7x across multiple IPs. Escalating to secops for forensic network logs.

secops-bot: Notifying #secops. Triggering key-rotation playbook for temp-key and starting token revocation.

Ravi: After rotate, rebuild and re-sign. No unsigned images allowed. Add detection: alert when cosign cert CN deviates or KMS unwraps originate outside corp IP ranges.

Lena: Good. Attach skopeo diffs between pinned digest and current blob to INC-2026-0318. Keep oncall looped.

Anika: Acknowledged — updating incident with diffs and runbook. :white_check_mark:
